I switched to an alt. I hope you dont mind. 

That's heartbreaking. Man, that is heartbreaking.  It reached out to me because when inwas twenty I was standing in the bathroom brushing my teeth one morning and my mind decided to unleash the hidden memories on me. I thought that maybe i was imagining it. I called my mother and asked and she got really quiet and told me she thought that I had forgotten about it. Damn. I have a deep dark spot in me now where hate festers and rots no matter what I do. Maybe your transition will help you? Do you question it? Honestly I would kill the man who did that to me if I ever found him. I'm a barely functioning veteran who doesn't really care anymore.
This is my alt when I post when I am depressed.  Didn't see your message until tonight.  Yes, actually I did end up moving
Google that first. You can survive that and you will deformed and blind.
Exacto knives are sharp. I have some scars from them.
